channel.title: The Multi-Rail Bank in 2026: Cards, A2A, Stablecoins, RTP, FedNow, and Open Banking in One Strategy
channel.description: The multi-rail bank in 2026 does not pick one payments future. It orchestrates cards, account-to-account payments, RTP, FedNow, stablecoins, Open Banking, wallets, and ISO 20022 data according to cost, speed, risk, finality, and customer context.

item.title: The Multi-Rail Bank in 2026: Cards, A2A, Stablecoins, RTP, FedNow, and Open Banking in One Strategy
